references.text: The tribe of Benjamin is counted again in the camp arrangement, with the same number of 35,400 men
The second census of the tribe of Benjamin shows 45,600 men, an increase from the first count
Benjamin's sons are mentioned when Jacob and his family went to Egypt, the patriarch of this tribe
Benjamin's birth is described, Jacob's youngest son from whom this tribe descends
Jacob's blessing over Benjamin, which prophesies about the tribe's warrior nature
